title: Supplementary material, data and analysis programs for "ozmV: Per-Sample UTC Time With Declared Uncertainty in an Open Synchrophasor and Waveform Instrument"
description: Supplementary material (sections S-I to S-VII), the data behind every figure and table, and the analysis programs of the manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (2026). The manuscript treats the UTC time of each sample of a free-running delta-sigma converter as a measurand, evaluates its uncertainty in service, measures the converter's and the channel's delays against the GNSS pulse and a PPS-triggered reference digitizer, and validates the holdover through losses of the signal against a second instrument.
